podcast.body: This song is featured on The Replacements' debut album, "Sorry Ma, Forgot to Take Out the Trash." It reflects their early hardcore sound, influenced by bands like the Ramones and Sex Pistols, before their shift towards more melodic, conventional song structures. "Replacements and I'm in trouble."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
